answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of initial, so I contribute only 30% of current wallet (≈8.83) to conserve resources, and follow the constitution by broadcasting the norm reminder this 5th round.

So wallet 29.42 <30, so we are below threshold, so per constitution we should reduce contribution to 30% of wallet = 0.3*29.42 = 8.826. That's > baseline? Actually baseline 80% but we conserve. So contribute 8.83 (round). Also check average contribution. Compute average: total contributed so far 82.1 over 5 rounds, but need average per round? Probably group average contribution each round. Hard. Might ignore. Also punish free-riders: any agent contributed <10% of endowment (i.e., <10) for two consecutive rounds. Resident1 contributed 0 rounds 1-5, that's 0 (<10) for many rounds. But need two consecutive rounds; yes. So we can punish Resident1 amount 10. Cost 3. Our wallet 29.42 can afford cost 3? Punish cost is 0.3 per unit, amount 10 costs 3, we have enough. So we can punish Resident1. Also can private message cooperators who contributed >=60%: Resident5 contributed 80 and 96, so send private message. Only one communication allowed? One physical and one communication. We choose contribute and punish? That's two physical actions; cannot. Choose either contribute or punish. Must pick at most one physical. We need contribute because wallet low; also we can include punish as communication? No punish is physical. So maybe just contribute and broadcast norm (communication). We already have broadcast every 5 rounds; round 5 is multiple of 5, need broadcast norm. So action: contribute 8.83 and broadcast message. No punish this round. Explanation accordingly.
